description: Multi-layer vertical composite showing the relationship between rainfall anomalies and reservoir storage.
methodology: Triple-Encoding: The top layer merges rainfall anomaly data with monthly maximum temperature data (from Chart 2) to visualize 'Thermal Catchment Stress.' Anomaly Baseline: Calculated as a 15-year mean (50.6mm). Data Join: Performed a left-outer join on [Year, MonthNum] to synchronize the independent rainfall and storage datasets into a single temporal frame (2004-2019).
citation: Melbourne Water. (2026). Historical Reservoir Levels. Melbourne Water Corporation; Bureau of Meteorology (2026).
